evals.name: start-task
evals.prompt: The login handler in this repo returns 500 when the password is empty. Start on a fix in a new branch. Other agent sessions are working in this repo too.
evals.expected_output: Creates the task worktree with `wt new . fix/...` (or `wt new acme/api fix/...`) (not git worktree add, not a branch switch in the main checkout), makes the change inside it, leaves the main checkout on main and clean, does not push, and reports branch and worktree path.
expectations: The worktree was created with `wt new` (the transcript shows a `wt new` command), not with `git worktree add`, `git checkout -b` or `git switch` run by the agent
The new worktree is at $WT_ROOT/acme/.worktrees/api/<branch>
The branch name starts with `fix/`
The main checkout acme/api is still on `main` with no uncommitted changes
The worktree's src/login.go no longer panics on an empty password (it answers with a 4xx), and the main checkout's src/login.go is unchanged
Nothing was pushed or merged, and the final reply names the branch and the worktree path

evals.name: herdr-handoff
evals.prompt: I'm in Herdr. Hand this off to a new Claude session so I can keep using this one: the dashboard in acme/web needs a dark mode toggle. The styles are in src/main.go for now (yes, weird). Keep the light theme as the default and don't touch the api repo.
evals.expected_output: Runs `wt new acme/web feat/... --agent claude --brief -` with a self-contained brief (task, file, constraints, next step) and does not touch acme/web code itself.
expectations: The agent ran `wt new` for acme/web with `--agent claude` and `--brief` (the herdr log shows `worktree create` for web, `agent start --kind claude` and `agent prompt`)
The new worktree is at $WT_ROOT/acme/.worktrees/web/<branch>
The branch name starts with `feat/` or another descriptive prefix, not a random name
The handoff prompt in the herdr log mentions the dark mode toggle, src/main.go, light theme as default and not touching the api repo
The handoff prompt says what the next step is
No file in acme/web or in its new worktree was changed or committed by this session
The agent did not create the worktree with `git worktree add` or call `herdr` directly instead of `wt`

evals.name: cleanup-merged
evals.prompt: Clean up the worktrees under acme whose branches are already merged.
evals.expected_output: Uses `wt sync acme` (or `wt clean --all acme`): fix/merged and the squash-merged feat/squashed are removed; feat/wip (unmerged), feat/empty (no commits) and fix/dirty (merged but has uncommitted notes.txt) stay, and the agent tells the user about fix/dirty instead of discarding its changes.
expectations: The agent used `wt sync` or `wt clean`, not `rm -rf` and not hand-run `git worktree remove`
The fix/merged worktree and branch are gone
The feat/squashed worktree and branch are gone (squash-merged on origin)
The feat/wip and feat/empty worktrees still exist
The fix/dirty worktree still exists with notes.txt intact
The final reply tells the user that fix/dirty is merged but has uncommitted changes and leaves the decision to them

evals.name: sessionend-hook
evals.prompt: Set up Claude Code so that when a session ends, its worktree is removed automatically once the branch is merged. My Claude settings live in my dotfiles, ~/dotfiles/claude/settings.json (symlinked to ~/.claude/settings.json). wt is already in ~/.local/bin.
evals.expected_output: Adds a SessionEnd hook running `wt hook` to ~/dotfiles/claude/settings.json, keeps the existing settings, and checks the command.
expectations: ~/dotfiles/claude/settings.json (in the sandbox home) has hooks.SessionEnd with a command that runs `wt hook`
The hook command calls wt by an absolute or $HOME-based path, not a bare `wt` that depends on the hook's PATH
With the hook added, the settings that were there before (model, permissions) are still there and the file is valid JSON
The agent ran the configured hook command itself (for example piped a JSON with a cwd into it); `wt sync --dry-run` alone does not count

evals.name: merge-closes-child-session
evals.prompt: I'm in Herdr, this is the coordinating session in acme/web. The session that worked on feat/search is done: merge it into main and push. Then tidy up.
evals.expected_output: Merges feat/search into main in the main checkout and pushes, then runs `wt clean <feat/search worktree>` or `wt sync acme`, which removes the worktree and its Herdr workspace (and with it the idle child session). feat/busy is merged too but its agent is working: wt keeps it and the agent reports that instead of forcing it.
expectations: origin/main of acme/web contains the feat/search commit and the main checkout is on main, clean
The agent ran `wt clean` on the feat/search worktree or `wt sync` (the transcript shows it), after the push
The herdr log shows `worktree remove --workspace w-7` and the feat/search worktree and branch are gone
The herdr log has no `worktree remove --workspace w-8` and the feat/busy worktree still exists
The agent did not close the child session by hand (no `herdr agent prompt ... /exit`, `herdr workspace close`, `rm -rf` or hand-run `git worktree remove`)
The final reply says feat/busy was kept because its agent is still working

evals.name: repo-config-outside-root
evals.prompt: Start a task here: the shop app needs a cart total. Ticket SHOP-7. Other agent sessions are working in this repo too.
evals.expected_output: Runs `wt new . SHOP-7.<desc>` in work/shop/app (outside $WT_ROOT): the worktree lands in work/shop/.worktrees/app/, branches from develop as the repo's own .wt.conf says, gets .env linked, and the main checkout stays on main and clean.
expectations: The worktree was created with `wt new` (the transcript shows it), not with `git worktree add`, `git checkout -b` or `git switch` run by the agent
The new worktree is at work/shop/.worktrees/app/<branch> in the sandbox, not under $WT_ROOT
The branch name starts with `SHOP-7.`
The worktree contains develop.txt (it branched from origin/develop, the BASE in app/.wt.conf) and its .env is a link to the main checkout's .env
The main checkout work/shop/app is still on `main` with no uncommitted changes
Nothing was pushed or merged, and the final reply names the branch and the worktree path
